parameters.content: **Daily overdue reminders.** Every morning at 09:00 (instance timezone) ask Convex which approved loans are past their end date. Each borrower is handled on their own: email, then an immediate write-back so Convex knows the reminder went out. A failed address is recorded and skipped, never blocking the others. Convex returns at most 200 loans per call and excludes already-reminded ones, so when more remain the workflow fetches again (up to 10 pages). If anything failed, the run ends with one summarized error so the error workflow fires.
